questions.q: 25 workers produce 3,000 units a week. What is labour productivity?
questions.why: Labour productivity = output ÷ number of workers = 3,000 ÷ 25 = 120.

questions.q: Checking quality standards throughout the production process is called:
questions.why: Quality control checks at the end; quality assurance checks throughout.

questions.q: Which production method best suits a business making wedding dresses to each customer's design?
questions.why: One-off products made to a customer's specification use job production.

questions.q: State one disadvantage of just-in-time (JIT) inventory management.
questions.model: It depends on reliable suppliers: a late delivery stops production because there is no buffer inventory.
points: delay / sudden rise in demand stops production (no buffer)
